name: trobanga
description: Claude Code plugins for test-driven development, coverage and mutation testing, architecture review, and game development

plugins.name: trobanga-skills
plugins.description: trobanga personal skills: workflow, docs, architecture, gamedev, and engineering skills

plugins.name: trobanga-progress
plugins.description: Progress bar above the prompt for the implement workflow, plus an agents panel (/agents-info): running, finished and planned subagents with model, step progress, context, cost and time.

plugins.name: prose-width
plugins.description: Wraps the prose of Claude's replies at 72 columns in a centered column on wide terminals; code fences keep their width. /prose-width sets the limit.

plugins.name: gloss
plugins.description: Select an item code (F3), a file reference (src/a.ts:12) or a commit hash in fullscreen mode, and a band above the prompt shows what it refers to. /gloss <token> does the same from the keyboard.
